category_title: Students with emotional and behavioural disabilities transitioning to mainstream vocational settings
minimal_context: Ian is in a mainstream woodworking class where he is supposed to be working on the construction of a side table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to start working on the construction of your side table. Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ian, you need to get to work on your semester-long independent project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. It's towards the end of term and I've missed classes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still have to do the work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Fails to start working) I'm unable to complete my project anyway, so I'm not doing it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: You need to start working on the construction of your side table. Who are you?

STUDENT: My name’s Ian.

TUTOR: Ian, you need to get to work on your semester-long independent project.

STUDENT: I'm not doing it. It's towards the end of term and I've missed classes.

TUTOR: You still have to do the work.

STUDENT: (Fails to start working) I'm unable to complete my project anyway, so I'm not doing it.

task.content: Learning woodworking techniques and completing a semester-long independent project: the construction of a side table
task.learning_goal: Transition to post-school settings, namely, to vocational education and a career in metals and engineering

context.environment: Woodworking class at School B (mainstream school)
context.materials: Materials for construction of a side table
context.social_setting: Accompanied by a student learning support officer
context.time_context: 2 days a week, approximately 4 hours per week, Thursdays and Fridays

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When a deputy or head teacher had to say something to him for behavioral correction
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Historically prone to backchat or argument, but in this setting accepted correction calmly

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Missed classes and was unable to complete his project
